Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to a rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. Driver 2 was stopped in traffic when the front of
Driver 1's vehicle struck the rear of Driver 2's vehicle. Driver 1 reported a shoulder injury and said the impact was the
cause. Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel when officers arrived, and a Passenger in the front seat was also
present and confirmed being in the vehicle at the time of the crash. Driver 2 gave a statement consistent with Driver
1's account of how the collision occurred, and two independent witnesses at the scene described the same sequence
of events. Officers photographed both vehicles. The rear damage to Driver 2's vehicle and the front damage to Driver
1's vehicle line up with the reported speed and angle of impact, and the officers observed no prior damage to either
vehicle. Driver 1 was checked at the scene and transported for evaluation. The shoulder complaint is a common
result of a collision of this type. Records confirm Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the
vehicle involved.
</page>
